More than one error situation handled

hazirlik_anlamlari.Yayına alınmamış nesne: Dependency on an SAP object that is not released or whose release state is unverified
hazirlik_anlamlari.Açık ATC/CVA bulgusu: Priority 1–2 finding not closed in ATC or CVA
hazirlik_anlamlari.Tasarım/sözleşme açığı: Missing design or contract information: counterpart schema, error codes, field list, sample message
hazirlik_anlamlari.Geçici çözüm / hardcode: Deliberately left hard-coded value or workaround
hazirlik_anlamlari.Karar bekleyen konu: A decision not yet made; every row a KARAR BEKLİYOR marker points to
hazirlik_anlamlari.İstisna kaydı yapılmamış bulgu: No approved exemption record for a known deviation (clean core level, ATC exemption)

parametre_notu: Thresholds and coefficients are assumptions made without seeing the scoring engine's code; they exist for the indicator, not as a target.

Write it into 7.3 as OPEN-nn with owner and date

bolumler.amac: Fixes the development's identity, type and extension approach in one place; decides which sections are mandatory.
bolumler.kural: Write at least one RICEF type into the top-level `turler` array; the type table is derived from it. The extension approach and the target clean core level follow the decision in the inputs; give a reason for any level other than A.
bolumler.iyi: Tür: Arayüz/API + Fiori/UI5. Yaklaşım: Developer extensibility (ABAP Cloud, RAP). Hedef seviye A: yalnız released API (I_PurchaseOrderAPI01) kullanılır.
bolumler.pratik: Clean core: consider key user first, then on-stack ABAP Cloud, then side-by-side BTP. Level A uses only released APIs; B classic APIs, C internal objects, D techniques that are not recommended (SAP clean core levels, 2025).

alanlar.ipucu: One line; states the business outcome
Sets the profile: Basit → hafif, Orta → standart, Karmaşık → tam

bolumler.not: The RICEF types are derived from the top-level 'turler' array; this section holds only fields.

bolumler.amac: Makes the UI5 and ABAP developers agree on one service contract.
bolumler.kural: Write the OData version, the backend model, the use of draft and the consumed standard APIs with their version and release contract.
bolumler.iyi: OData V4, RAP managed + draft, servis binding ZUI_PO_SEND_LOG_O4 (OData V4 – UI). Tüketilen: I_PurchaseOrderAPI01 (C1).
bolumler.pratik: Fiori elements is recommended for apps that fit a supported floorplan; features such as draft and flexible column layout reduce front-end code. Release contract: C0 extend, C1 use system-internally, C2 use as remote API.

bolumler.amac: Shows how the work runs today and at exactly which step the problem arises.
bolumler.kural: Write the process step by step: who does what, in which application. Flag the problem step, give its measurable effect and one real example (document number, date).
bolumler.iyi: Adım 3: Satınalmacı onaylı siparişi 'Manage Purchase Orders' (F0842A) uygulamasından PDF alıp e-posta ile gönderir. Günde ~120 sipariş; 12.05.2026'da 4500001234 numaralı sipariş 2 gün geç iletildi.
bolumler.kotu: Mevcut süreç manuel ilerlemekte ve sorunlar yaşanmaktadır.
bolumler.pratik: The business need is written before the solution; without the volume (items/day) the technical design is sized wrongly.

alanlar.ipucu: Duration, error rate, cost; as numbers

sutunlar.ipucu: Fiori App ID, transaction code, Excel…

ornek_satir: Onaylı siparişin PDF'ini e-posta ile tedarikçiye gönderir
Sipariş başına ~4 dk; ayda ~15 unutulan gönderim

bolumler.amac: Defines the solution, the SAP technology used and which As-Is problem each requirement solves.
bolumler.kural: Write every requirement as one sentence and one behaviour in an EARS pattern. Every REQ links to an As-Is step and carries a Given-When-Then acceptance criterion.
bolumler.iyi: REQ-01: Satınalma siparişi onayı tamamlandığında (ReleaseIsNotCompleted = boş), sistem siparişi 5 dakika içinde tedarikçi portalına REST ile gönderir. Çözdüğü: ASIS-03.
bolumler.kotu: Sistem siparişleri otomatik ve hızlı şekilde ilgili yerlere iletecektir.
bolumler.pratik: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148: a requirement is necessary, singular, unambiguous and verifiable. EARS patterns: '<sistem> … yapar' · 'While <durum>' · 'When <olay>' · 'Where <özellik>' · 'If <istenmeyen durum> then'.

alanlar.ipucu: e.g. RAP, Application Job, Communication Arrangement

ornek_satir: Satınalma siparişi onayı tamamlandığında sistem siparişi 5 dk içinde tedarikçi portalına gönderir.
Given onaylı 4500001234; When job çalışır; Then portal 201 döner ve log kaydı 'Gönderildi' olur.

bolumler.amac: Names the main flow and every variant / exception; the source of the test cases.
bolumler.kural: Give every scenario an SC id. Write the trigger, the precondition and the variant; do not skip empty, zero and boundary cases.
bolumler.iyi: SC-02: Sipariş gönderildikten sonra değiştirilirse (LastChangeDateTime > gönderim zamanı) sipariş yeniden gönderilir, log'da sürüm 2 oluşur.
bolumler.pratik: Edge cases are what gets skipped most: write the behaviour for empty fields, null values and out-of-range input.
ornek_satir: Seç → JSON oluştur → POST → log yaz

bolumler.amac: Summarises the As-Is and To-Be flow visually; makes the order of steps indisputable.
bolumler.kural: If the inputs contain or cite a diagram, record it; otherwise the To-Be flow may be drawn as `mermaid` source from the steps the inputs describe (drawing a stated step is not a design decision). Every box carries an SC or STEP id. If most steps wait for decisions, switch the section off with that reason; do not write 'to be added later'.
bolumler.iyi: D-01 To-Be akış (BPMN): Onay → Job → POST → Log; kutular STEP-01, STEP-02, STEP-03 kimlikleriyle etiketli.
bolumler.pratik: The diagram does not repeat the text; it shows order and decision points. Mermaid in Obsidian, a pasted image in Word/Excel.

bolumler.amac: Draws the scope boundary: what we depend on, what we assume to be true, what we deliberately do not do.
bolumler.kural: Fill all three dimensions: at least one Bağımlılık, one Varsayım, one Kapsam dışı. Every row has an owner and a verification status.
bolumler.iyi: OOS-01 Kapsam dışı: Sözleşme (outline agreement) çağrı siparişleri gönderilmez. ASM-01 Varsayım: Portal aynı siparişi 'Idempotency-Key' başlığıyla tekilleştirir (portal ekibi, 10.05.2026'da doğrulandı).
bolumler.pratik: Scope is written as IN / OUT and frozen by sign-off; otherwise it keeps growing.

alanlar.ipucu: One sentence: what this development does

ornek_satir: Portal REST uç noktası /api/v1/orders test ortamında açık olmalı

bolumler.amac: Lists what must be ready in the system before development and testing start.
bolumler.kural: Write every precondition with its type, its concrete value and the system/tenant it is needed in. 'Hazır mı' is 'Hayır' unless the inputs report it ready.
bolumler.iyi: PRE-02 Uyarlama: Satınalma siparişi esnek iş akışı etkin (Manage Workflows for Purchase Orders), şirket kodu 1710. Test tenant'ında hazır.
bolumler.pratik: In Public Cloud, business configuration is done in the customizing tenant and moved by transport; a communication arrangement is set up separately in every system.

bolumler.amac: Defines at field level the criteria the report or job runs with.
bolumler.kural: For every selection field write the source field, type, mandatory flag, single/multiple/range selection, default and value help.
bolumler.iyi: CompanyCode · I_PurchaseOrderAPI01.CompanyCode · CHAR(4) · zorunlu · çoklu · varsayılan 1710 · değer yardımı I_CompanyCodeStdVH.
bolumler.kotu: Şirket kodu, tarih vb. alanlar olacak.
bolumler.pratik: In the cloud the selection screen is a Fiori elements filter bar or application job parameters.

bolumler.amac: Defines the floorplan, the elements and their behaviour so the UI5 developer can build the screen without asking.
bolumler.kural: Write the floorplan and its reason. For every screen element give the label, the behaviour condition, the annotation/control and the STEP it triggers.
bolumler.iyi: UI-04 Aksiyon 'Yeniden gönder': yalnız Status = 'E' satırlarda etkin; @UI.lineItem type #FOR_ACTION, dataAction 'resend'; STEP-07'yi çağırır.
bolumler.pratik: Fiori elements floorplans: list report, worklist, object page, analytical list page, overview page. If the design does not fit them, freestyle or the flexible programming model is chosen and the reason is written.

bolumler.amac: Defines where every field comes from, where it goes and how it is transformed on the way.
bolumler.kural: Every row is one field mapping: source object.field → target object.field, data type, mandatory flag, transformation rule and one real example value.
bolumler.iyi: MAP-03: I_PurchaseOrderItemAPI01.OrderQuantity (QUAN 13,3) → JSON items[].quantity (number, zorunlu); birim ISO koduna çevrilir; örnek 120.000 → 120.

bolumler.not: For type U without an external interface this section maps source (CDS / API field) → service entity property: yon and comm_scenario are —, protokol is the OData version of 1.2, tetikleyici is the user action.

bolumler.amac: Gives the developer the logic to code as ordered, individually verifiable steps.
bolumler.kural: Write at least 3 steps. Every step names a concrete SAP object (CDS, API, class, BAdI); write which MSG is raised on error and the commit/rollback behaviour.
bolumler.iyi: STEP-02: I_PurchaseOrderAPI01'den ReleaseIsNotCompleted = boş ve LastChangeDateTime > son çalışma zamanı olan siparişleri oku. Kayıt yoksa MSG-01 (I) yaz ve bitir; veritabanı değişikliği yok.
bolumler.kotu: Gerekli kontroller yapıldıktan sonra ilgili tablolardan veriler okunur ve sisteme kaydedilir.
bolumler.pratik: In RAP the commit belongs to the framework: persistence happens in the save sequence, COMMIT WORK is not written. ABAP Cloud uses only released APIs; ATC checks this.

What is persisted, what is rolled back

bolumler.amac: Defines what the system does when the same request arrives twice, an operation stops halfway, or a retry happens.
bolumler.kural: For every topic write the decision and the related STEP: idempotency key, retry policy, timeout, partial success, reprocessing.

bolumler.amac: Records the technical agreement with the counterpart system: endpoint, authentication, SLA, error contract.
bolumler.kural: For every integration write the endpoint, the communication scenario/arrangement name, the authentication, the SLA and the HTTP code → behaviour mapping.
bolumler.iyi: INT-01: POST /api/v1/orders · OAuth 2.0 client credentials · ZCS_PO_SUPPLIER_PORTAL · 201 başarı, 409 yinelenen (başarı sayılır), 4xx kalıcı hata, 5xx tekrar denenir · yanıt ≤ 3 sn.

bolumler.amac: Defines acceptable duration and data volume as measurable targets.

bolumler.amac: The single catalog of every custom and standard SAP object named in the document.

bolumler.iyi: OBJ-03 · ZBP_R_PO_SEND_LOG · CLAS (behavior implementation) · Yeni · paket ZMM_PO_SEND · ABAP for Cloud Development · STEP-04, STEP-07.

bolumler.amac: Defines in which situation which message is raised, with which type, and what the system does.

bolumler.pratik: A message is written so the user understands the next step. In RAP, messages return through the 'reported' structure; unwanted situations use the EARS 'If … then' pattern.

bolumler.amac: Proves in one table that every requirement is designed, coded and tested.

bolumler.amac: Defines in which order and with which transport vehicle the objects go live, and the manual steps.

bolumler.amac: Makes every undecided topic visible with its owner and date.

sutunlar.ipucu: As a question; except the rows 'DOĞRULANACAK nesneler: …' and 'Teknik taslak geliştirici onayı bekliyor: …'
